datasets.title: Marshall Islands Sea Ports (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['amenity'] = 'ferry_terminal' OR tags['building'] = 'ferry_terminal' OR tags['port'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en amenity building port operator:type addr:full addr:city source name:it This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_mhl_sea_ports]
datasets.details: OpenStreetMap data is crowd sourced and cannot be considered to be exhaustive

lineage.description: Sea port infrastructure features were extracted from OpenStreetMap using tag-based filtering (amenity='ferry_terminal', building='ferry_terminal', port IS NOT NULL) and exported by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team in multiple vector formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) with point, line, and polygon geometries to create a spatial inventory of maritime infrastructure in the Marshall Islands.
